description: Apache Superset is a Data Visualization and Data Exploration Platform

latest_release.body:
Hello Community,

The Apache Superset team is pleased to announce that Superset
6.1.0 has just been released.

Apache Superset is a modern, enterprise-ready business intelligence web application.

The official source release:
https://downloads.apache.org/superset/6.1.0

The PyPI package:
https://pypi.org/project/apache_superset/6.1.0

The CHANGELOG for the release:
https://github.com/apache/superset/blob/6.1.0/CHANGELOG/6.1.0.md

The instructions for updating to the release:
https://github.com/apache/superset/blob/6.1.0/UPDATING.md

If you have any usage questions or have problems when upgrading or
find any issues with enhancements included in this release, please
don't hesitate to let us know by sending feedback.

hot_issues.title: [SIP-116] Simplifying time period filtering for users
[SIP-96] Proposal for adding a notification feature
after upgrading to 6.0.0 the embedding dashboarding is broken
Line chart legend resets it's state whenever you scroll down the page
[SIP-225] Proposal for author-configured hierarchical drill-down on dashboard charts
Line chart skips intermediate categories when x‑axis is string (but data exists)

discussions.title: Restrict access to data uploaded by a user to only that one user
Show how old a dashboard's source data is ("Data as of"), configured per dataset
Is a custom SemanticLayer extension the right way to query an Apache Ossie model stored in Apache Polaris?
feat(erd): show primary keys and relationship columns in generated diagram
SQL Lab: keep the selected schema when switching to a database that has it
RBAC-only with a non-empty scope for the MCP server
Table chart paginations not reset properly on applying date range filter - version 6.1.0
Date range badge not shown as applied in table charts - 6.1.0
